answer: Each identity locks 70 credits and plants one beacon on the tundra rim, key-bound. Each epoch the beacon must send a signed heartbeat inside the 30-minute delta window; auditors replay the chain and burn bonds for missing, late, or copied heartbeats. One beacon costs 45 to plant, so 1,000 fakes owe 45,000 for a 40,000 pool. A rented-beacon ring fails since each heartbeat is key-signed and chained; honest agents pay 45 once, bond kept.
